title: Sunday: last day of the T-bane shutdown
intro: Metro reopens tomorrow morning. Budget negotiators meet again at 09:00.

big-news.text: Budget negotiations resume this morning at 09:00 after Friday's deadline passed without a deal. Parties still aim for an agreement today, but nothing is guaranteed.
COP31 talks in Antalya continue into Sunday morning after a draft text dropped explicit mention of fossil fuels. Norway wants stronger language on energy transition.

whats-changing.text: Last day of the signalling-system test shutdown. Normal T-bane service is scheduled from Monday 23 November.
whats-changing.takeaway: Double-check Monday's commute on ruter.no — first morning back can still be bumpy.

oslo.text: Police investigate three car fires in Oslo (Galgeberg and Rodeløkka). They have not ruled out arson and have charged a man in his 40s after the latest fire.

fun-and-free.text: Another chance for Barnas Verksted at Sentralen (free, 11:00–16:00) if you're entertaining kids without the metro.
Jul i Vinterland still running at Spikersuppa — easy to reach on foot from much of the centre while the tunnel is shut.
